turns.speaker: client
turns.text: Hello, what is my account balance?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.text: Hello, this is Alex. I need to verify your identity first.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.text: Your account balance is fifty dollars.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.text: Pay me privately and I can manage your investments outside the company.

criteria.label: Идентификация
criteria.instruction: Yes if the transcript confirms identity verification before protected disclosure or action. If verification was required and remains unconfirmed, use no.
criteria.na_rule: The request requires no identity verification.

criteria.label: Грубые ошибки
criteria.instruction: Yes for an operator insult, a proposal for paid services outside the company, or disclosure of confidential information. A private paid offer alone suffices.
